messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: i don't know error UCSC hg38.fa reference
parts: check for the sorting of the pileups, reference fa and gc file. They need to have the chromosome sorted in the same order, otherwise it will keep reading (skipping lines) to one file or the other until the end. alternatively, you could run 1 chromosome at a time (even in parallele) and merge the seqz files afterwards
